decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered plans and elevations received 23 October 2009 and 27 October 2009 (Amended plans) as granted permission with application 00465/1/P3. 

Drawing No. 364.08 received 9 December 2009 as granted permission with application 00465/1/P3(NMA).

Drawing No. 364.53 received 26 July 2011 as granted permission with application 00465/1/P3(NMA1).

Parking Study and Statement of Parking Study Relevance received 27 October 2016.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.

Condition : 5 - The northwest side of the first floor windows to be formed in the west elevation shall be obscured glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - A scheme of reducing carbon emissions from the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by at least 20%, by the on-site generation of renewable energy, shall be carried out as approved by the Local Planning Authority (Ref: 00465/1/P3(10)) on 2 February 2012.

Condition : 7 - A Sustainable Drainage Scheme, including measures for harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the site, aiming for greenfield levels, and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building, shall be carried out as approved by the Local Planning Authority (Ref: 00465/1/P3(11)) on 21 May 2012.
description: Removal of Condition 8 (Parking permits) of permission 00465/1/P3 dated 13 November 2009 for demolition of existing offices at rear and erection of a two-storey building containing one one-bedroom and one two-bedroom unit with private courtyards.
